name: Weeknight Chicken Tacos
ingredients: 1.5 lb boneless chicken thighs|2 tsp chili powder|1 tsp cumin|1 tsp garlic powder|1 lime|8 small corn tortillas|1 cup shredded cabbage|1/2 cup sour cream|Fresh cilantro
instructions: Toss the chicken with chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, and a big pinch of salt.|Cook in a hot skillet 5–6 minutes per side until cooked through. Rest 5 minutes, then slice.|Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.|Fill with chicken, cabbage, sour cream, and cilantro. Squeeze lime over the top.
notes: Thighs stay juicier than breasts here.

name: Brown Butter Banana Bread
ingredients: 3 very ripe bananas|1/2 cup butter|3/4 cup brown sugar|1 egg|1 tsp vanilla extract|1 tsp baking soda|1/2 tsp salt|1.5 cups all-purpose flour
instructions: Heat oven to 350°F and grease a loaf pan.|Melt the butter in a small pan and cook until it smells nutty and turns golden brown. Let cool slightly.|Mash the bananas in a bowl. Stir in the brown butter, sugar, egg, and vanilla.|Stir in the baking soda and salt, then fold in the flour until just combined.|Bake 55–65 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
notes: Freezes well sliced — toast straight from frozen.

name: Overnight Oats
ingredients: 1/2 cup rolled oats|1/2 cup milk|1/4 cup Greek yogurt|1 tbsp chia seeds|1 tbsp maple syrup|Berries for topping
instructions: Stir the oats, milk, yogurt, chia seeds, and maple syrup together in a jar.|Cover and refrigerate overnight.|Top with berries in the morning.
notes: Makes a week's worth if you multiply by 5.

name: Roasted Tomato Soup
ingredients: 2 lb roma tomatoes, halved|1 yellow onion, quartered|4 cloves garlic|3 tbsp olive oil|2 cups vegetable broth|1/2 cup heavy cream|Fresh basil
instructions: Heat oven to 425°F.|Spread the tomatoes, onion, and garlic on a sheet pan. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.|Roast 35–40 minutes until soft and charred at the edges.|Transfer to a pot with the broth and blend until smooth.|Stir in the cream, warm through, and top with basil.
